affected_subject.reason: Identifies _updateLimitPostOrder and the order book doubly-linked list as affected component.

trigger_or_action.reason: Adding a new order via _updateLimitPostOrder with memory-passed order parameter triggers the faulty storage update.

direct_effect.reason: New order fails to store prevOrderId, breaking backward links and making list partially one-directional.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected bidirectional linked-list consistency vs actual missing prev reference, plus removal causing incorrect head reassignment and loss of preceding orders.

summary: Report identifies the function, trigger, concrete linked-list corruption effect, and expected-vs-actual list integrity relation, sufficient to attempt formalization.
